name: Kiritani Akihito
source:
"Betting everything, that's what resolution means."

The owner of 'Dance Trips'.
A noncommittal and vague kind of guy.
He doesn't really have an attachment to the shop and is thinking that if he can't sell it he'll just close the shop down.
